statements.quoted_span: Landlords of rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), which includes dwelling units, suites, condominiums, duplexes, guest rooms, and rooms in a hotel, motel, rooming house or boarding house occupied by the same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days in the City of Los Angeles with a certificate of occupancy first issued before October 1, 1978, must pay interest on all security deposits held for at least one (1) year for their tenants.
